meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Spotify's sign-up bar and Premium promos; toggles for shelves, sidebars, buttons, footer; blur or hide cover art
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless): iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA on open.spotify.com (home), DOM captured after 7 seconds. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts of that DOM (text stripped, only needed ancestors, `data-keep` on main view, Log in button, player controls and the phone tab bar).

LIVE desktop: `[data-testid="signup-bar"]` 1, `#global-nav-bar a[href="/download"]` 1, `[data-testid="card-image"]` 54, `[data-testid="component-shelf"]` 5, `[data-testid="left-sidebar-footer"]` 1, Log in and Sign up buttons 1 each. LIVE phone: `[data-testid="premium-banner"]` 1, `[data-testid="home-card"] img` 84, `[data-testid="carousel-mwp"]` 5, `[data-testid="masthead-footer"]` 1. The original cookie rule matched `#onetrust-consent-sdk` and its banner (2) on both; ad and app-banner rules matched nothing.

Choices: Cover art Show/Blur/Hide; Home shelves Show/Dim/Hide. The selectors use Spotify's data-testid attributes; the generated class names are hashed and are not used.

**Second check (2026-11-17).** Opened `https://open.spotify.com/` logged out in a desktop-UA browser at 1440×900 and read the DOM 9 seconds after load. `recipes/fixtures/spotify/desktop-live-home.html` is a trimmed reconstruction of what was found. Seen live and used: `aside[aria-label="Now playing view"]`, `nav[aria-label="Main"]` (the left sidebar), `[data-testid="browse-button"]`, `signup-button`, `language-selection-button`, `footer-div`, `play-button` (40), `carousel-previous-button` and `carousel-next-button`, and home shelves labelled Trending songs, Popular artists, Popular albums and singles, Popular radio and Featured Charts.

NOT verified: Shows to try, Episodes for you, Made For You and Recently played did not appear on the logged-out page; their labels come from a public uBlock filter list (nkorth.com/ublock.html) and a userscript, so those two options may do nothing for some accounts. Shelf rules match English shelf titles. Logged-in player and pages, the phone layout for the new options, album, artist and playlist pages; the Premium, Support and Download buttons in the top bar (no stable attribute, text only, so not touched). Ads: the Now playing bar exposes `data-testadtype` and the audio ads themselves cannot be removed by CSS.
